notes: The 2026 page listed jobs by the youngest age. Aquatics aide and lifeguard: 15 and up. Community center recreation leader: 16 and up. Library teen volunteer: 13 to 17, a younger age range than the fair's 14 to 25 invitation. BioPark education volunteer: 14 and up. Dates are for the 2026 fair.
name: One Albuquerque Youth Job & Volunteer Fair
what_you_do: A fair each year where youth meet City teams and local employers. You learn how to apply and sign up for seasonal jobs, internships and volunteer roles.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 25. Each youth must register. Parents do not need to register.
pay_detail: Event is free. Jobs listed there are paid; pay not stated on the page.
deadline_text: 2026 fair was Saturday Feb 7, 2026, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Berna Facio Professional Development Center. 2027 date not posted.
how_to_apply: Register on the fair page for the youth who will attend.
